ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Attachment Manager Settings Associations Tamper
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects tampering with attachment manager settings policies associations to lower the default file type risks (See reference for more information) Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Associations\\\\.*") AND ((registry_path = RGX("\\\\DefaultFileTypeRisk$") AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00006152\)") OR (registry_path = RGX("\\\\LowRiskFileTypes$") AND (Details = RGX(".*\\\.zip\\;.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\.rar\\;.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\;.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\.bat\\;.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\.com\\;.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\.cmd\\;.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\.reg\\;.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\.msi\\;.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\.htm\\;.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\.html\\;.*"))))
